add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
spec2def(mspatcha.dll mspatcha.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# mspatcha.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mspatcha-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mspatcha_shims OBJECT mspatcha_main.c lzx.c)
target_link_libraries(mspatcha_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(mspatcha mspatcha-cargo mspatcha.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mspatcha_shims psdk)
